argv:
import json, pathlib, subprocess
bt = chr(96)
m = json.loads(pathlib.Path("harness-manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert m["release"] == {"version": "3.1.0", "required_tag": "v3.1.0"}, m["release"]
o = m["ownership"]
roots, inst, upd = o["install_payload_roots"], o["install_payload_paths"], o["update_paths"]
tracked = subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files", "scripts", "schemas"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split()
for p in tracked:
    if p != "scripts/install-harness.sh":
        assert p in upd, "missing from update_paths: " + p
    if p not in ("scripts/install-harness.sh", "scripts/update-harness.sh"):
        assert p in inst, "missing from install_payload_paths: " + p
for p in ("scripts/harness-path.sh", "scripts/drive-cli.sh", "scripts/drive_cli_rules.py", "scripts/drive-cli.rules.json", "schemas/worker-output.schema.json", "scripts/model_id.py"):
    assert p in tracked and p in inst and p in upd, "not shipped: " + p
cap = "docs/missions/capabilities"
assert cap in roots and cap in upd and cap not in inst, "capability baselines must be a payload root and an update path"
for p in roots + inst + upd:
    assert pathlib.Path(p).exists(), "manifest path missing on disk: " + p
payload = subprocess.run(["python3", "scripts/harness-manifest.py", "--root", ".", "install-payload"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.splitlines()
for cli in ("agy", "claude", "codex", "cursor-agent"):
    assert pathlib.Path(cap, cli + ".txt").is_file() and cap + "/" + cli + ".txt" in payload, "baseline not in install payload: " + cli
top = pathlib.Path("CHANGELOG.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n## ")[1]
assert top.startswith("3.1.0 (2026-10-"), top[:30]
lines = top.splitlines()
limit = "- drive-cli residuals: boxed menus and alternate-screen redraws are not classified as prompts; the driver sends no input and the run ends as an exit-4 stall."
assert limit in lines and lines.index("### Known limits") < lines.index(limit), "drive-cli residual missing from Known limits"
i = next(n for n, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith("- **Autopilot driver ("))
assert i < lines.index("### Known limits"), "drive-cli bullet out of place"
j = next(n for n in range(i + 1, len(lines)) if lines[n].startswith("- ") or not lines[n].strip())
bullet = " ".join(line.strip() for line in lines[i:j])
for tok in ("scripts/drive-cli.rules.json", "Boxed menus and alternate-screen redraws are accepted residuals that end as an exit-4 stall."):
    assert tok in bullet, "drive-cli bullet lacks: " + tok
rel = pathlib.Path("docs/RELEASING.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "updated: 2026-10-18" in rel.split("---")[1].splitlines(), "RELEASING.md updated date"
assert "The current release is " + bt + "3.1.0" + bt in rel and "The current release is " + bt + "3.0.0" + bt not in rel, "RELEASING.md current release"
assert "Phase 1 execution truth" not in rel, "tag message still hard-coded to Phase 1"
assert 'git tag -a "v$RELEASE_VERSION" -m "v$RELEASE_VERSION"' in rel.splitlines(), "tag line"
print("ok")
git ls-files -z '*.json' | xargs -0 -n 1 sh -c 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m json.tool "$1" >/dev/null' sh
git diff --check && git diff --check HEAD~1 HEAD
